title: RiskProduct API canonical envelope
description: Envelope wrapping every API response under /api/v1.5.0/. Resolves PD-008: rubric_version and data_as_of are mandatory on every response so downstream integrators can distinguish protocol-data changes from rubric-version bumps. The `data` field shape varies per endpoint.

rubric_version.description: Frozen rubric version string, e.g. v1.5.0. Matches the published rubric changelog entry current at grade-computation time.

data_as_of.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the most recent factor_score collected_at across the response payload. Distinct from generated_at: the rubric may re-evaluate without new factor data arriving. May be the Unix epoch (1970-01-01T00:00:00Z) when no scores have been collected.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when this dump ran (when the JSON file was last written by dump.py).

data.description: Endpoint-specific payload. Shape documented per-path in openapi.yaml.
